schema.description: Segmented transfer envelope stream containing the requested payload segment and trailing footer metadata.
Segmented transfer envelope stream containing serialized PutTransferSegmentRequest metadata followed by the segment payload bytes.
Stream transfer envelope stream containing the requested payload segment and trailing footer metadata.
Stream transfer envelope stream containing serialized PutStreamTransferSegmentRequest metadata followed by the segment payload bytes.

AbortTransferRequest.description: Request to abort a staged upload transfer session.

Aborted.description: Whether staged transfer resources were removed.

AbortTransferResponse.description: Response indicating whether a staged upload transfer was aborted.

CloseTransferSessionRequest.description: Requests closure of a retained read transfer session.

Closed.description: True when the session was closed or was already absent from the authorized catalog.

CloseTransferSessionResponse.description: Reports whether the retained read transfer session is closed.

ItemID.description: Immutable data item identifier associated with the transfer session.

oneOf.description: Finite segmented transfer state when the session is backed by segmented transport.
Stream transfer state when the session is backed by stream transport.

TransferFamily.description: Transfer family currently backing the server session.

DataControlServerSessionInfo.description: Transfer session inspection record returned by session inventory APIs.

DataControlTransferFamily.description: Client transfer family used to route and interpret transfer sessions.

DataItemTransferIdentity.description: Identity for a segmented transfer session.

DataItemTransferMode.description: Transfer session role used to interpret transfer state and behavior.

ContentStreamed.description: Whether the data item uses streamed content.

DataItemTransferObjectInfo.description: Small descriptive summary of the serialized data item associated with a transfer.

Offset.description: Starting byte offset of the range.

Length.description: Length in bytes of the range.

EndOffsetExclusive.description: Exclusive ending offset of the range.

IsEmpty.description: Whether the range length is zero.

DataItemTransferRange.description: Half-open byte range within a staged transfer stream.

MinSegmentBytes.description: Minimum allowed payload size in bytes.

MaxSegmentBytes.description: Maximum allowed payload size in bytes.

DataItemTransferSegmentSizePolicy.description: Advertised segment size guidance for a staged transfer session.

ObjectSHA512.description: SHA-512 of the serialized object payload.

SourceSessionID.description: Optional source session identifier for follower read sessions.

oneOf.description: Optional server-authoritative integrity summary for verified stream segments.

DataItemTransferState.description: Current state view of a segmented transfer session.

AppendedLength.description: Current durable appended length in bytes.

ObjectSHA512.description: SHA-512 of the serialized object payload when present.

SourceSessionID.description: Optional source session identifier for follower sessions.

oneOf.description: Optional server-authoritative integrity summary for verified stream chunks.

DataStreamTransferState.description: State view describing the current status of an append or follow stream-transfer session.

Length.description: Requested read payload length in bytes.

Offset.description: Requested read offset within the durable appended prefix.

GetStreamTransferSegmentRequest.description: Metadata carried in a stream-transfer segment read request.

GetStreamTransferStateResponse.description: Response containing the current state of a stream-transfer session.

TransferFamily.description: Transfer family of the requested session.

PrefixLength.description: Exact prefix length for which integrity evidence is requested.

GetTransferIntegrityEvidenceRequest.description: Requests authoritative integrity evidence for a transfer prefix.

SourceSessionID.description: Canonical source session identifier, when the requested session follows another transfer.

SourceStateVersion.description: Source state version associated with this evidence snapshot, or null for immutable published content.

Integrity.description: Integrity summary for the requested prefix.

Segments.description: Canonical source segments covering the requested prefix.

IsPublished.description: True when the requested prefix is backed by immutable published content.

GetTransferIntegrityEvidenceResponse.description: Returns authoritative integrity evidence for a transfer prefix.

Length.description: Requested read payload length in bytes.

GetTransferSegmentRequest.description: Metadata carried in a segmented transfer read request.

ItemID.description: Optional immutable data item identifier filter.

oneOf.description: Optional transfer status filter applied to the current session state.

GetTransferSessionsRequest.description: Administrative request used to query DataControl transfer session inventory.

GetTransferStateResponse.description: Response containing the current staged transfer state.

SessionID.description: Gets the transfer session identifier to inspect.

InspectPublicationRequest.description: Identifies a transfer session whose publication recovery footprint is requested.

OpenFollowStreamTransferRequest.description: Request to create a follower stream-transfer session over an active source session.

ObjectPayload.description: Serialized source object payload used to reconstruct the followed data item.

OpenFollowStreamTransferResponse.description: Response containing the current state of a follower stream-transfer session.

SourceSessionID.description: Optional staged upload session identifier when opening a follower read session over active staged content.

OpenGetTransferRequest.description: Request to create a new readable segmented session over published content.

ObjectPayload.description: Serialized data item payload bound to the published readable session.

OpenGetTransferResponse.description: Response containing the current state of a PublishedRead segmented session.

ObjectPayload.description: Optional serialized object payload used to initialize the stream-transfer session.

ObjectSHA512.description: SHA-512 of the serialized object payload when present.

OpenStreamTransferRequest.description: Request to create a new source stream-transfer session.

OpenStreamTransferResponse.description: Response containing the current state of a source stream-transfer session.

ObjectSHA512.description: SHA-512 of the serialized object payload.

OpenUploadTransferRequest.description: Request to create a new staged segmented upload session.

OpenUploadTransferResponse.description: Response containing the current state of a staged segmented upload session.

BlobName.description: Gets the Blob name within the item container.

Length.description: Gets the recorded artifact length, when available.

SHA512.description: Gets the recorded artifact SHA-512 digest, when available.

OperationID.description: Gets the associated stream-chunk operation identifier, when applicable.

Offset.description: Gets the range or chunk offset, when applicable.

PublicationRecoveryArtifact.description: Describes an artifact candidate or recorded Blob reference in a recovery footprint.

InspectedAt.description: Gets the UTC time at which the database snapshot was read.

ExternalArtifactExistenceChecked.description: Gets whether external artifact existence was checked; inspection currently always returns false.

ItemID.description: Gets the item identifier associated with the transfer.

SessionStateVersion.description: Gets the session state version used as a purge freshness condition.

OperationID.description: Gets the publication operation identifier, when a journal exists.

oneOf.description: Gets the publication journal phase, when a journal exists.

JournalUpdated.description: Gets the journal update timestamp used as a purge freshness condition.

FailureCount.description: Gets the number of recorded publication failures.

LastError.description: Gets the sanitized recorded publication error, when available.

ExpectedStateVersion.description: Gets the state version expected by the publication journal.

ExpectedObjectLength.description: Gets the recorded expected serialized object length.

ExpectedObjectSHA512.description: Gets the recorded expected serialized object SHA-512 digest.

ExpectedStreamLength.description: Gets the recorded expected stream length, when applicable.

oneOf.description: Gets the recorded stream integrity evidence, when applicable.

StagingArtifacts.description: Gets staging Blob references recorded by the session and journal.

StagingPrefix.description: Gets the session-specific staging Blob prefix.

FinalArtifacts.description: Gets candidate final artifact names and any recorded metadata; these artifacts remain under operator control.

oneOf.description: Gets the recorded stream integrity evidence, when available.

PublicationRecoveryFootprint.description: Describes the recorded recovery state and artifact candidates for one transfer session.

PublishSegmentedTransferRequest.description: Request final validation and publication of a fully realized staged transfer.

PublishSegmentedTransferResponse.description: Response describing the post-publication state of a staged transfer session.

oneOf.description: Optional refined object summary to publish at completion.

FinalObjectPayload.description: Optional refined serialized object payload to publish at completion.

FinalStreamLength.description: Optional final stream length used to validate the server-authoritative integrity summary.

PublishStreamTransferRequest.description: Request final validation and publication of a stream-transfer session.

PublishStreamTransferResponse.description: Response describing the post-completion state of a stream-transfer session.

ItemID.description: Gets the item identifier expected to own the session.

CatalogName.description: Gets the catalog expected to own the session.

ExpectedSessionStateVersion.description: Gets the session state version returned by inspection.

ExpectedOperationID.description: Gets the journal operation identifier returned by inspection, or null when no journal existed.

oneOf.description: Gets the journal phase returned by inspection, or null when no journal existed.

ExpectedJournalUpdated.description: Gets the journal update timestamp returned by inspection, or null when no journal existed.

ConfirmPurge.description: Gets the required explicit confirmation to purge session state and staging Blobs.

PurgePublicationRequest.description: Requests deletion of one transfer session's staging Blobs and DataControl database state.

SessionID.description: Gets the purged transfer session identifier.

OperationID.description: Gets the publication operation identifier, when one was journaled.

StagingArtifactsDeleted.description: Gets whether the session staging prefix was deleted.

DatabaseStateDeleted.description: Gets whether the journal, session, and dependent transfer metadata were deleted.

FinalArtifactsDeleted.description: Gets whether final published artifacts were deleted; this operation always returns false.

CatalogDataDeleted.description: Gets whether catalog data was deleted; this operation always returns false.

FinalArtifactCandidatesLeftUntouched.description: Gets candidate final artifact names left untouched by purge.

Message.description: Gets a summary of the cleanup boundary.

PurgePublicationResponse.description: Reports the DataControl cleanup performed for a transfer session.

AppendedLength.description: Current durable appended length after processing the request.

Replayed.description: Whether the request matched an already-committed append.

PutStreamTransferSegmentResponse.description: Metadata carried in a stream-transfer segment append response.

CompletedCoverage.description: Whether full logical coverage exists after acceptance.

Range.description: Logical range associated with this upload result.

Replayed.description: Whether the request matched an already-committed range.

Updated.description: Authoritative manifest update time for an accepted segment, when available.

PutTransferSegmentResponse.description: Metadata carried in a segmented upload envelope response.

RemoveTransferRequest.description: Request to remove retained transfer session state.

Removed.description: Whether retained transfer resources were removed.

RemoveTransferResponse.description: Response indicating whether retained transfer session resources were removed.

ReOpenFollowStreamTransferRequest.description: Request to reattach to an existing follower stream-transfer session.

ObjectPayload.description: Serialized source object payload used to reconstruct the followed data item.

ReOpenFollowStreamTransferResponse.description: Response containing the current state of a reopened follower stream-transfer session.

ReOpenGetTransferRequest.description: Request to reattach to an existing readable segmented session.

ObjectPayload.description: Serialized data item payload bound to the readable session.

ReOpenGetTransferResponse.description: Response containing the current state of a reopened readable segmented session.

ObjectSHA512.description: SHA-512 of the serialized object payload when present.

ReOpenStreamTransferRequest.description: Request to reattach to an existing source stream-transfer session.

ReOpenStreamTransferResponse.description: Response containing the current state of a reopened source stream-transfer session.

ObjectSHA512.description: SHA-512 of the serialized object payload.

ReOpenUploadTransferRequest.description: Request to reattach to an existing staged segmented upload session.

ReOpenUploadTransferResponse.description: Response containing the current state of a reopened staged segmented upload session.

Digest.description: Digest of the ordered verified content-segment metadata.

SegmentCount.description: Number of verified content segments used to compute the digest.

TransferContentIntegrity.description: Describes server-authoritative integrity for ordered verified transfer content.

TransferContentIntegritySegment.description: Describes one verified content segment used by the canonical integrity digest.
